name: knoux-grabflow-vscode
description: Inspect streaming manifests (HLS/DASH), generate FFmpeg assembly commands, and invoke KNOuX GrabFlow desktop companion directly from VS Code.

commands.title: KNOuX GrabFlow: Inspect Stream / Media URL
KNOuX GrabFlow: Assemble HLS/DASH Stream via Companion
KNOuX GrabFlow: Copy FFmpeg Assembly Command

knouxGrabflow.ffmpegPath.description: Absolute path to local FFmpeg executable.

knouxGrabflow.ffprobePath.description: Absolute path to local FFprobe. A bare name is resolved to an absolute path before use; the child process never inherits the caller's PATH.

knouxGrabflow.pythonPath.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used for companion assembly. Leave empty to use an auto-detected absolute path; a bare name is never resolved through an inherited PATH.
